content.short: CompareNodes publishes independent performance benchmarks and a directory of blockchain RPC providers.
content.description: CompareNodes is an independent directory and benchmarking service for Web3 infrastructure, tracking thousands of public endpoints from over 200 providers across hundreds of protocols and measuring JSON-RPC, WebSocket and gRPC latency. Blockscout's app marketplaces for Unichain and World Chain list it.
content.meta: CompareNodes benchmarks and lists RPC providers across hundreds of chains, including Unichain and World Chain.
